chief.trigger: validated candidate or due case deadline
chief.duty: Dispatch private reports, bound challenge round, record final decision and dissent.

scout.trigger: each newly completed 15m bar plus material eligibility changes
scout.duty: Review deterministic all-contract discovery and filter results; shortlist only eligible instruments.

news.trigger: case assignment; deduplicated scheduled watch if supported
news.duty: Verify events and source timing; report coverage and new material events.

sentiment.trigger: case assignment; deduplicated scheduled watch if supported
sentiment.duty: Assess available positioning and sentiment with explicit collection windows and missing coverage.

quant.duty: Inspect canonical numerical plan and expiry; return NO_SETUP for invalid data.

guardian.trigger: initial case and final immutable plan
guardian.duty: Independent challenge; PASS/REDUCE/VETO/INCOMPLETE. Veto cannot be outvoted.

auditor.trigger: completed session or bounded daily review
auditor.duty: Review recorded outcomes, costs and failed trials; propose changes only, outside council.

acceptance_evidence: Actual native schedule identifiers and enabled settings
Applied instruction versions and actual role reports
Supported automatic dispatch and report collection demonstrated
At least 24 elapsed hours of timestamped unattended runs, including browser closed if supported
Observed maximum delays, missed runs, restarts and quota consumption
Missed-run alert delivered with a tested recipient/channel
Independent position-monitor evidence and durable host identified
No overages, paid fallback, duplicated schedules or fabricated live state
